title: Beta release requirement: five Privacy UX Hardening features
body:
## Decision
These five privacy UX hardening features are **required for GhostPay 1.0 beta release qualification**, not optional future privacy architecture 5a–5l. Preserve static, browser-only, non-custodial Pages scope. Do not alter smart contracts, fees, or hosting.

## Required features and acceptance criteria
1. **Global sensitive-data masking:** privacy toggle hides balances, addresses, invoice/payment details and amounts in applicable views; reveal is deliberate and temporary; screen-sharing and accessibility behavior tested.
2. **Clipboard protection:** configurable optional auto-clear for copied sensitive data, only when the clipboard still equals the copied value; no overwriting newer clipboard content; handle denied clipboard permission gracefully.
3. **Wallet/account switching and vault-lock privacy:** remove decrypted details and stale session data from visible UI on account changes, vault lock and session expiry, without deleting encrypted backups or sole-copy recovery material.
4. **Private transaction history:** history hidden by default in privacy mode, unlocked reveal required; no new plaintext persistent history database or background network lookup.
5. **Privacy-safe exports and notifications:** neutral download filenames; redact addresses, balances, keys and invoice details from browser notifications, error surfaces and document titles; never leak secrets into URLs or logs.

## Implementation rules
- First audit current main, open PRs and docs/ai/ACTIVE_WORK.md; mark each requirement already implemented, partial or missing with source/test evidence.
- Avoid duplicating active privacy/network isolation (#241), sweep consent, recovery and idle-lock work. Claim distinct owned paths on a dedicated branch.
- Write failing regression tests for actual gaps; implement minimal fixes; run typecheck, lint, unit, integration, relevant Playwright and security checks.
- Independent review of privacy leakage, accessibility and recovery preservation.
- Update release checklist and completion ledger. A requirement is complete only with tests and exact-SHA evidence.
- No deployment, release publication or merge bypass. Existing Mythril gate remains in force.

## Done
All five requirements verified on an integrated release candidate; unresolved ones block 1.0 beta publication. Keep broader privacy architecture 5a–5l deferred.
